description: Register one player into a tournament (player-side sign-up; no manage code needed). Duplicate-checked by email. TWO STEPS: first call WITHOUT confirm — it returns a summary and writes nothing; show that summary to the user, and only after they explicitly approve, call again with the same fields plus confirm=true to commit.

confirm.description: Set true only after user confirms the summary

division.description: Optional division / group label, if the event uses divisions

email.description: Player email — duplicates are detected by this address

name: register_player
